message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
- Small tomatoes (~90 g) have about 15–18 kcal.  
- Large tomatoes (~180 g) contain around 30–35 kcal.  

So, depending on the size, you can expect anywhere from ~15 kcal for a small tomato up to ~35 kcal for a large one.
